title: Effect of Labetalol, Atenolol, and Nifedipine on Maternal Hemodynamics Measured by ICG in Early Pregnancy
official: The Effect of Labetalol, Atenolol, and Nifedipine on Maternal Hemodynamics Measured by Impedance Cardiography in Early Pregnancy
summary: The purpose of the research is to characterize the effect of labetalol, atenolol, and nifedipine on maternal hemodynamics early in pregnancy. Patients will be given medication based on their hemodynamics and asked to return for a repeat measurement.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients presenting to Maternal Hypertension Center at Cabell Huntington Hospital
* English speaking
* 18-45 years old.
* Willing to provide informed consent
* Gestational age prior to 15 weeks gestation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Non-English speaking patients, patients
* \<18 years old or \>45 years old
* Not willing or able to provide consent
* Gestational age \>15 weeks

sites.f: Maternal Hypertension Center at Cabell Huntington Hospital
